steps.prompt: What do both sentences tell you about what actually happened?
options: he crashed the plane in a town, and he was an ordinary burglar
nothing — they are about the future
he did not crash in a town, and he was not an ordinary burglar

steps.model: If I hadn’t …, I wouldn’t have …

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ tell a thief from a robber , a burglar and an outlaw
✓ talk about crime and punishment — arrest, capture, sentence, fine, escape
✓ imagine a past that did not happen — If I had…, I would have…
✓ keep would out of the if half, one tense further back
✓ soften the result with might have and could have
✓ use the inversion — Had I known…
